metadata.description: VFX pipeline plugins for Claude Code - Nuke, Houdini, Unreal, Blender, ComfyUI, Maya, Magnific, and Seedance. Skills, agents, and MCP connectors for AI-assisted VFX production.

plugins.name: vfx-core
plugins.description: Foundation package - install first. Cross-application skills and agents: search, documentation, testing, Python, planning, skill/agent creation, git safety guardrails, and session wrap-up. Registers core MCP servers (brave-search, context7, desktop-commander).

plugins.name: nuke-vfx
plugins.description: Nuke compositing pipeline: node graphs, BlinkScript, Cattery AI inference, Python scripting, tiling tool, batch shot setup, and Magnific-in-Nuke.

plugins.name: houdini-vfx
plugins.description: Houdini VFX pipeline: procedural generation, USD/Solaris, VEX, Python automation, HDA creation.

plugins.name: unreal-vfx
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5.8 VFX pipeline via the native UE MCP (ModelContextProtocol plugin + VibeUE toolsets): Blueprint automation, PCG, actor operations, Sequencer, Python scripting.

plugins.name: blender-vfx
plugins.description: Blender VFX pipeline via the official Blender MCP (blender.org): modeling, animation, materials, geometry nodes, physics, rendering, sculpting, grease pencil, and ControlNet pass rendering for AI generation.

plugins.name: comfyui-vfx
plugins.description: ComfyUI pipeline via the ComfyUI MCP and Comfy CLI, with optional ComfyUI_FL-MCP for live canvas operations: workflow analysis, node/model requirements mapping, and headless generation guidance, plus the previs-to-photoreal anchor keyframe recipe for reference-guided video generation.

plugins.name: comfyui-node-dev
plugins.description: ComfyUI custom node development: V3 API node structure, schemas, datatypes, inputs/outputs, execution lifecycle, frontend extensions, V1-to-V3 migration, and packaging/publishing.

plugins.name: maya-vfx
plugins.description: Maya pipeline via MCP: scene control, geometry creation, materials (Arnold/USD), transforms, and FBX import/export.

plugins.name: magnific-vfx
plugins.description: Magnific AI generation via MCP: image generation with model selection and references, local file upload/download pipelines, and video generation.

plugins.name: seedance-vfx
plugins.description: Seedance 2.0 video generation direction: prompt writing, camera, lighting, motion, characters, style, VFX, troubleshooting, and production recipes.
